title: tc-agent-inbox
description: Background agent tasks as a board (or list): Needs you, Running, Done.

tasks.description: The tasks – always the source of truth. After Approve, Reject or Retry the card shows the result right away; as soon as you pass that task with a new status (or steps, start or elapsed time), your version wins

heading.description: Heading on the left of the bar

expanded.description: The id of the unfolded card, or null

openable.description: Shows an Open button on running and done tasks (fires tc-open)

since.description: The start of the recap's period, in epoch ms – when you left. Set, Recap joins the layout switch

now.description: The time now, in epoch ms – the recap's period ends here and the clocks of waiting and running tasks hold at it; unset reads the clock

locale.description: Locale for the recap's times of day

description.description: One or two sentences on what the task is about or where it stands

agent.description: Name of the agent or model, e.g. "Opus 5.5"

startedAt.description: When the task started – the clock ticks from here while it runs or waits

elapsed.description: How long it took in ms – shown for done and failed tasks

tools.description: Tool calls so far – shown with a small wrench

sources.description: Sources or files read – shown with a small magnifier

steps.description: What the agent did so far, oldest first – the last four are shown when the card is open

finishedAt.description: When the task last changed – finished, failed or stopped to ask you. The recap places it here on its chart, and leaves it out when it's before `since` (unset: the start plus `elapsed`)

undoable.description: A done task that can be taken back: the recap shows Undo on it
